notes: One row per FLUXCOM-X-BASE source file (84: GPP/NEE/ET/ET_T x 2001-2021), keyed by source_key (variable_year_005), for package-level traceability. icos_object_pid_url is the object's ICOS metadata landing page (meta.icos-cp.eu/objects/<hash>, a persistent identifier); icos_access_url is the direct data download endpoint used here (data.icos-cp.eu/objects/<hash>, requires the same anonymous licence-acceptance cookie as icos_object_pid_url does not). sha256_hex is standard sha256sum/shasum -a 256-compatible; sha256_base64 is ICOS's own reported checksum encoding, kept so both can be cross-checked against a fresh download from either angle.
